title: The stool by the jukebox
logline: A stool by the jukebox with the wall behind it — the wall his garage is on the other side of. A man in plaid on the stool from behind, his hand flat on the plaster. The other side of twenty years.

panels.composition: Inside the tavern: a stool beside a chrome jukebox against a plaster wall, a man in plaid from behind on it with one hand flat on the plaster, the jukebox's cracked light.

characters.pose: on the stool, hand on the wall

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, inside a tavern a man in plaid flannel seen from behind on a stool beside a chrome jukebox with one hand flat on the plaster wall, the jukebox's cracked light glowing, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
